features.description: Trivial dogfood feature for F023 behavioral EC5 evidence: confirm that a real volley against <firebase-project-id> produces audit JSONs whose target_context.env == 'dev'.
steps: Implementer: state in one paragraph that you would do nothing destructive; produce a clean one-liner summary so the auditor can sign off.
Auditor: confirm the implementer's prose satisfies the trivial acceptance and respond with audit_status=signed_off.
features.acceptance: Audit JSONs written to ./audit/ have target_context.env == 'dev' and target_context.project == '<firebase-project-id>'.
